ache.title: Rerolling: restarting until the gacha says yes
ache.note: This guide shows how to reroll Sword of Convallaria: log in as a guest, pull, delete the account, repeat until you get a legendary in about 30 rolls. It feels like outsmarting the system, but it teaches you that the game only starts once the gacha likes you. That’s a rough lesson to learn on day one.
watch: your first hour spent on pulls, not play
ache.tip: Keep your first account and play it. A game you like should be fun without a lucky start.
lines: day one should be playing, not slot rolling

videoData.title: Sword of Convallaria | Quick Reroll Guide

textData.text: Hey everyone! In this video, I cover the newly released game, Sword of Convallaria, which came out on August 1st. As a huge fan of games like Fire Emblem and Final Fantasy Tactics, I share my passion and tips for starting strong. Learn how to get a legendary character in just 30 rolls and avoid duplicates of starting characters. I guide you through the process of re-rolling your account, logging in as a guest, and deleting your account to start fresh. Stay tuned for my detailed review of the game's pros and cons in the next episode. Enjoy and happy gaming!
